source.original_correspondence: Use receipt.refined_grid.x_source_centers and y_source_centers for sampled native texels; do not multiply native coordinates by a uniform scale. No new normalization.
source.coordinate_convention: Native pixel-boundary coordinates: (0,0) is top-left outer corner; pixel (i,j) center is (i+.5,j+.5); y increases down. Landmark values identify visible boundary locations, not new source samples.
source.annotation_method: Manual visible-corner annotation after viewing native PNG and reading its alpha/RGB boundaries. Not automatic geometric recovery.

target.projection: screen=(ppu*dot(right,X)+originX, -ppu*dot(up,X)+originY); allocate from projected bounds, never fit to prior image dimensions
target.source_to_target_axis_note: Source image shows its right end. Target camera sees local Xmin. Source left-to-right long direction therefore maps +X to -X. This is an explicit left/right appearance reflection, not a claim that an unseen opposite end was recovered. Symmetric frame/end-panel reuse is only an experimental assumption.

faces.support: Visible wooden cap top. Boundary is an approximate manual corner annotation.
Facade projection experiment only: products, shelf lips and cap overhang are flattened onto this face. NOT a planar reconstruction of these details.
End-panel envelope with top overhang and bottom feet merged. NOT exact board geometry.

actual_frame_two_face_alternative.purpose: If whole-envelope holdouts fail, do not integrate it. Restrict experiment to the main frame below the separately protruding wooden cap. No source top face is invented for this alternative.
actual_frame_two_face_alternative.cap: Separate component needs its own thickness/overhang specification; its outer top A/B/C/D are not main-frame top corners.

source_holdout_segments.confidence: provisional visual endpoints; recheck actual lip pixels before evaluating residual
provisional visual endpoints; recheck actual lip pixels before evaluating residual

raster_contract.matrix: One getPerspectiveTransform per source face using the shared vertex IDs. Target points only from target projection formula.
raster_contract.sampling: Inverse target texel-center mapping; source RGBA nearest texel; transparent outside source and face polygon. No palette changes, downscale/upscale pass or second PerfectPixel pass.
raster_contract.depth: The same selected target face owns color, alpha and surface XYZ. No unrelated enclosing ray-box fallback.
raster_contract.edge_ownership: Single top-left/half-open rule and shared target edge; do not repair seams by dilation.
raster_contract.source_outside_polygons: Report all omitted opaque source texels. They must not silently disappear or be clamped onto a border. This outline annotation does not yet guarantee zero omissions.

failure_is_not_repaired_by: claiming homography success proves source planarity

limits: This is an urgent bounded three-face envelope experiment, not certified plane reconstruction or a production-ready asset.
The shelf has overhanging cap, feet, multiple shelf depths and rounded products. A single cuboid cannot give all their edges the physically correct angle.

Target edge orientation is determined exactly by the camera/template; original interior edges are only correct if the source region actually obeys one projective plane. Test holdouts, not the four fitted corners alone.
Nearest sampling preserves selected source colors, not every source texel or all small features. Track provenance and compression.
No hidden surfaces are available. No target view rotation is supported by this single-view experiment.
Counter register, bags and other raised props are explicitly outside this whole-three-face method.
